claims.text: Radioactivity was discovered by Henri Becquerel in 1896, the electron by J. J. Thomson in 1897, and radio waves were demonstrated by Heinrich Hertz in the late 1880s.
One of Röntgen's first X-ray images, made in December 1895, showed the bones of his wife's hand and her ring.
Röntgen won the first Nobel Prize in Physics, in 1901.
